mechanism: Benazepril may reduce uric acid excretion or pyrazinamide's uricosuric effects may be antagonized, increasing hyperuricemia risk; additionally, ACE inhibitors can potentiate renal effects in patients with compromised kidney function during TB treatment.
action: Monitor serum uric acid levels and renal function regularly; consider allopurinol prophylaxis if hyperuricemia develops; assess for gout symptoms during concurrent therapy.
